name: Ray Marching Voxel Textures with Neighbor-Sensitive Masking
aliases: Hybrid Geometry-Shader-spawned cubes with ray marched volume textures
definition: A hybrid rendering technique using geometry shader instancing for component-level boxes and ray marching through dense volume textures for the interior, utilizing a neighbor-sensitive mask to determine voxel visibility based on surrounding components.
summary: This hybrid method renders dense voxels by combining geometry shader instancing with ray marching, using neighbor-sensitive bitmasks to hide internal faces without storing dense geometry.
